comparison.objective: Vent a pressure pan before removing and placing its lid; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a vent control, wait for steam to stop, lift a lid level by its knob, and place it on a trivet; no fastener or tuning operation.
comparison.success_condition: Vent first, remove lid only after steam stops, place it flat, release, and withdraw. Exact pressure/steam/timing thresholds and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-critical ordered actuation and lid handling rather than adjustable damping.
